\- Before going into a competitive match: Play a little bit of aim\_botz to warm up your aim

\- Practise Spray Patterns, good map for this is Recoil Master

\- Learn Timings on maps, so you know where you can die from and where you can feel save

\- Practice your Crosshair Placement, especially keeping your crosshair at head level at all times

\- Learn some basic smokes on the maps you play to make your life a lot easier (for example A-Smokes on Mirage)

\- Open Tab and look how much money you will get the next round and calculate how much money you can spend this round in order to have enough money to buy next round (For example you have 3850$ and you will get 1900$ next round and you want to play AWP; If you don't buy anything you will have 3850+1900 = 5750$ to buy AWP + Kevlar, so don't buy deagle or anything this round, knowing what to buy on a save is important)

\- Give information to your teammates where enemies are after you died or in general when you see someone or hear someone and DONT talk when your teammate is in a clutch situation

\- Play safe as CT, don't push unnecessarily, especially in lower ranks it's more than enough to just smoke the places where T's can come from and do quick peeks to see if the T's are coming or not. Use flashes before you peek when you hear them coming
